title: Rosmarinus officinalis essential oil for medicinal use
intro: Rosmarinus officinalis essential oil is a concentrated aromatic extract derived from the leaves of the rosemary plant. It is widely used in herbalism for its stimulating and antioxidant properties. This preparation is often employed to support cognitive function, alleviate muscle pain, and promote skin health. It can be applied topically, diluted with a carrier oil, or used in aromatherapy diffusers. In traditional medicine, it has been valued for its ability to enhance circulation and relieve respiratory congestion.
